column3: “My judgment” makes the object of “revoke it” explicit.
“Ruler of Moab” interprets “judge from her midst.”
“My judgment” makes the object explicit; the active clause about their lies becomes passive.
“Have relations” makes “go to the girl” explicit; the opening recasts panting after dust on the poor person’s head as trampling.
“In your place” interprets “under you”; “as with a cart” changes the comparison with a cart that presses.
“Prevail by his strength” interprets “strengthen his strength.”
“Even” is added; “bravest” renders the one strong of heart.
